scope: Read-only public-source comparison; no foreign board settings or hardware changes applied.

observations: adoptAndRead retains a hardware DMA-buffer reset note dated 2026-10-17; it is a test instrument, not the normal transport.
Controller and stream inputs are supplied for SM7325; they are not T970 board evidence.
Public firmware integration includes vendor HALIOMMU, clock, SCM and UFSDxe references.
The referenced PatchedBinaries/UFSDxe.inf is not present in the inspected public directory; no complete vendor binary reproduction is claimed.
Maintainer reports root/cryptex, launchd, persistent Data and Hello/Setup; home screen remains unverified.
Host checks SM8250 clock offsets and owned DMA, then replans two streams after queue quiesce.
Inherited-state RAM-payload firmware path; different prerequisites from the T733 vendor UFS dispatch.
CPU0 early XNU initialization reported; UFS root is still in progress.
Samsung SM8250 kernel reference agrees with upstream Linux and umi on AXI/AHB/UniPro/ICE/AUX offsets. Not a new target hardware measurement.

local_findings: BoardInit.c retains four mismatched unused clock macros but currently skips GCC writes; this is not proof of a hardware-reset cause.
The observed read-only BOOT does not run the clock diagnostics, PHY initialization or transport.
next_action: Correct and validate SM8250 diagnostic inputs, then combine bounded stream and guarded power/HCI/queue observations before choosing any takeover or firmware change.
